title: Broca's Area
text: Broca's area in the frontal lobe controls speech production. Damage causes Broca's aphasia - the patient understands language but cannot speak fluently.

title: Wernicke's Area
text: Wernicke's area in the temporal lobe is responsible for language comprehension. Damage causes Wernicke's aphasia - fluent but meaningless speech and difficulty understanding others.
